session.zh: 跨市场收盘 · 美国 / 香港 9 月 18 日
session.en: Cross-market close · US / Hong Kong Sep 18

headline.zh: 长端利率回到 5% 附近但美股仍小幅收高；港股科技股反弹，DRAM 现货延续产品分化。
headline.en: Long yields returned near 5% while US equities still edged higher; Hong Kong technology rebounded and DRAM spot pricing remained selective.

summary.zh: 截至上海时间 9 月 19 日早晨，9 月 18 日是美港最近完整交易日。标普 500 上涨 0.2% 至 7,650.50，纳指上涨 0.4% 至 26,522.55。AP 报道 10 年期美债收益率升至 5.00%，布伦特原油短暂跌破每桶 102 美元后回到 103 美元上方。恒指上涨 146 点或 0.6% 至 24,750，恒生科技指数上涨 2.2%。TrendForce 的 9 月 18 日现货报价显示 DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 上涨 1.39% 至 56.00 美元，DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 下跌 0.23% 至 46.036 美元，DDR4 16Gb (2Gx8) 3200 下跌 0.29% 至 85.75 美元。
summary.en: As of the morning of September 19 in Shanghai, September 18 was the latest completed US and Hong Kong session. The S&P 500 gained 0.2% to 7,650.50 and the Nasdaq gained 0.4% to 26,522.55. AP reported the 10-year Treasury yield rose to 5.00%, while Brent briefly fell below $102 per barrel before returning above $103. The Hang Seng gained 146 points, or 0.6%, to 24,750 and the Hang Seng Tech Index gained 2.2%. TrendForce's September 18 spot quotes showed DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 up 1.39% to $56.00, DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 down 0.23% to $46.036, and DDR4 16Gb (2Gx8) 3200 down 0.29% to $85.75.

label.zh: 利率韧性与风险偏好并存
label.en: Yield resilience coexists with risk appetite

title.zh: 长端利率接近 5% 时，风险资产的反弹仍要经受融资与估值约束检验。
title.en: With long yields near 5%, risk-asset rebounds still face financing and valuation constraints.

detail.zh: 利率、油价和权益市场的当日变化是事实；将其解读为估值与风险偏好拉锯是分析判断，不预测政策、通胀或企业盈利。
detail.en: The daily moves in yields, oil and equities are facts; reading them as a valuation-versus-risk-appetite tension is analysis, not a forecast of policy, inflation or earnings.

label.zh: 美国 10 年期国债收益率 · Sep 18

title.zh: 长端利率上行但美股小幅收高
title.en: Long yields rise while US equities finish modestly higher

detail.zh: AP 报道 10 年期美债收益率升至 5.00%，标普 500 上涨 12.74 点至 7,650.50，纳指上涨 104.25 点至 26,522.55。指数表现说明当日风险偏好，并不直接证明 AAPL、GOOGL 或 MSFT 的经营变化。
detail.en: AP reported the 10-year Treasury yield rose to 5.00%, while the S&P 500 gained 12.74 points to 7,650.50 and the Nasdaq gained 104.25 points to 26,522.55. The index moves show that day's risk appetite, not an operating change at AAPL, GOOGL or MSFT.

title.en: Hong Kong technology shares lead a rebound

detail.zh: RTHK 报道恒指上涨 0.6% 至 24,750，科技指数上涨 2.2%。单日反弹不能替代对 0700.HK AI 回报或 9992.HK 海外执行的基本面验证。
detail.en: RTHK reported the Hang Seng gained 0.6% to 24,750 and the tech index gained 2.2%. A one-day rebound does not substitute for validating 0700.HK's AI returns or 9992.HK's overseas execution.

title.zh: 油价波动仍影响通胀与估值背景
title.en: Oil swings still shape the inflation and valuation backdrop

detail.zh: AP 报道布伦特原油短暂跌破每桶 102 美元后回到 103 美元上方。单日油价变化不单独决定通胀路径、货币政策或企业利润。
detail.en: AP reported Brent briefly fell below $102 per barrel before returning above $103. One-day oil moves do not by themselves determine the inflation path, monetary policy or company profit.

title.zh: DRAM 现货继续分化，不能直接外推周期
title.en: DRAM spot pricing remains mixed and cannot define the cycle

detail.zh: TrendForce 的 9 月 18 日现货页显示 DDR5 16Gb 上涨 1.39%，DDR4 8Gb 与 DDR4 16Gb 分别下跌 0.23% 和 0.29%。日度现货变化不是合约价格、HBM 盈利、出货或 DRAM 基金回报的替代指标。
detail.en: TrendForce's September 18 spot page showed DDR5 16Gb up 1.39%, while DDR4 8Gb and DDR4 16Gb fell 0.23% and 0.29%. Daily spot moves are not substitutes for contract pricing, HBM profitability, shipments or DRAM ETF returns.
